put.summary: Set the environment's access-protection bypass token
put.description: For protected previews (e.g. Vercel Deployment Protection's Protection Bypass for Automation). Stored sealed with ENCRYPTION_KEY, never returned, sent only to the environment's own origin, and never recorded in evidence.

post.summary: Run a platform diagnostic (database, queue, object storage)
post.description: Verifies the CodeSentra pipeline end to end for this project's organization. Watch it with GET /v1/runs/{id}/stream.

get.summary: A run with its steps and coverage gaps

get.description: Emits `run` events whose data is a full Run snapshot: one immediately, then one after every step or status change. The stream ends after the run reaches a terminal status. A `: ping` comment is sent every 15 s.

post.summary: Start Sentra Pulse on an environment
post.description: Checks the environment's deploy URL: reachability, platform, rendering, routes (including the latest Scan's routes) and hygiene. A Link run follows: findings become issues with fix prompts, traced to code when the project has a Scan, and earlier issues are re-checked.

post.summary: Quick Pulse: check any public URL, no project needed
post.description: The run belongs to the given organization; findings and fix prompts are returned by GET /v1/runs/{id}/findings. No issues are stored.

post.summary: Upload a zip or register a git ref
post.description: Send a zip as the raw request body with `Content-Type: application/zip` (at most 209715200 bytes; extraction limits are applied at ingest), or JSON `{ "kind": "git", "url"?, "ref"? }` for a public https repository.

post.summary: Start Sentra Scan
post.description: Scans a snapshot (or, without snapshot_id, the project's GitHub repository or repo_url at its default branch): map, history, sandboxed probes, dependency audit, secrets, feature inventory and an evidence-verified report.

post.summary: Start a direct upload of a zip
post.description: For zips of any size up to 209715200 bytes: the browser POSTs the file straight to object storage with the returned form (the policy pins the key, the type and the size), then calls .../uploads/{snapshot_id}/complete. Nothing passes through the web app or this API.

post.summary: Finish a direct upload
post.description: Checks the uploaded object (present, within the size limit, a zip by its signature) and marks the snapshot ready to scan. A rejected object is deleted.

get.summary: Scan report: verified claims with evidence, features, health breakdown, coverage

post.summary: Full check: Scan + Pulse in parallel, then Link
post.description: Scans the given snapshot (else the project's GitHub repository at its default branch when the GitHub App covers it, else its repo_url, else its latest uploaded snapshot) and runs Pulse on every environment (or the one given), in parallel. When both finish, a Link run traces each issue to code, writes its prompt and re-checks earlier issues. Returns the Link run. A module that cannot run (no snapshot, no environment, no object storage) is a gap of the Link run.

post.summary: Targeted re-check
post.description: Re-runs just the check group the issue's re-check names (Pulse: that group, after reachability and platform; Scan: a new Scan of the project's GitHub repository or repo_url), then Link re-evaluates the issue. Returns the Link run.

post.summary: GitHub App webhooks
post.description: Signed with GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET (X-Hub-Signature-256) and deduplicated by X-GitHub-Delivery: a replayed delivery is acknowledged and does nothing. Handles installation, installation_repositories, pull_request (opened/synchronize/reopened), deployment_status (success) and push.

get.summary: Install the GitHub App for an organization
get.description: Redirects an org admin to GitHub to install the App. The signed state ties the installation back to this org and user; GitHub's setup redirect returns to /v1/github/setup.

GitHub redirects here after installation. installation_id is not trusted: the user-authorization code must show that this user can access the installation, and the signed state must name an org they administer.

get.summary: GitHub installations linked to the organization

post.summary: Create a recurring Pulse or full check
post.description: Runs Pulse (then Link) on the environment whenever the five-field UTC cron matches, at most every 5 minutes. worker-link fires due schedules; a missed window is not replayed.

post.summary: Add an email channel
post.description: Alerts (new and regressed issues, with their prompts) are emailed to this address. It must belong to a member of the organization. Slack channels are added with GET /v1/projects/{id}/notifications/slack/install.

get.description: Redirects to Slack to pick a channel (incoming-webhook scope). Slack returns to /v1/slack/callback, which stores the webhook sealed.

post.summary: Create an API token
post.description: The token is returned once and never again. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. It can act only in this organization, with your role in it.
